verifications.claim: Italy's Constitutional Court upheld Law 74/2025 on March 12, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'Italy’s Constitutional Court rejected constitutional challenges to Law 74/2025 on 12 March'; R7: 'Italy's Constitutional Court on March 12 upheld a 2025 law'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the court upheld Law 74/2025 on March 12 (contextually 2026).

verifications.claim: Italy's Constitutional Court rejected challenges from the Tribunal of Turin.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'questions of constitutional legitimacy raised by the Turin court'; R6: 'questions raised by the Tribunal of Turin'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state the court addressed and rejected challenges from the Tribunal of Turin.

verifications.claim: Italy's Constitutional Court found the challenges to the restrictive law partly unfounded and partly inadmissible.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '“The Constitutional Court has declared the questions of constitutional legitimacy raised by the Turin court partially unfounded and partially inadmissible.”'; R6: same phrasing
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote in sources matches the claim exactly.

verifications.claim: Italy's Constitutional Court upheld the Tajani Decree.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'The law, commonly known as the Tajani Decree... upholding the generational cap'; R7: 'the "Tajani decree," is named after'
verifications.reasoning: Tajani Decree is explicitly identified as Law 74/2025, which the court upheld.

verifications.claim: The Tajani Decree passed in March 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'emergency law brought forward in March 2025'; R5: 'law that was announced... on Mar. 28, 2025'; R6: 'introduced last year via emergency decree'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm the decree was issued in March 2025.

verifications.claim: For applications submitted after March 27, 2025, citizenship by descent is limited to those with a parent or grandparent born in Italy.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'only those with parents or grandparents born in Italy'; R4: 'for applications submitted after March 27, 2025... parent... or... grandparent... born in Italy'; R6: 'unless... A parent or grandparent holds... Italian citizenship'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly state the limitation for post-March 27, 2025 applications to parent/grandparent born in Italy.

verifications.claim: The changes apply to applications made after March 27, 2025.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R4: 'for applications submitted after March 27, 2025'; R6: 'application filed by 11:59 p.m. Rome time on 27 March 2025'; R2: 'Applications submitted following the entry into force of Decree-Law no. 36 of 28 March 2025'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly apply changes to applications after the March 27, 2025 cutoff.

verifications.claim: The 2025 decree and subsequent ruling did not affect the approximately 60,000 applications already pending at consulates or in court at the time of the initial decree.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R6: 'roughly 60,000 applicants who filed before the 27 March 2025 cutoff continue under the old... rules'; R9: 'did not affect the applications of roughly 60,000 people that were pending at the time'

verifications.claim: It is no longer possible to apply for citizenship by descent based on a great-grandparent or older ancestor unless the parent or grandparent born in Italy requirements are met.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'only those with parents or grandparents born in Italy will be seen as citizens'; R5: 'only if they have an Italian citizen parent or grandparent'; R7: 'restricting citizenship to persons with an Italian parent or grandparent'
verifications.reasoning: Sources state the new limit excludes great-grandparent or older unless parent/grandparent criteria met.
